# gitmoap_repository_milestone (Data Source)

Get a milestone and its burndown. Returns one of the repository's milestones with the work items in it and their progress: how many are open, completed and cancelled, and the total and completed points. Only work items you can see are listed or counted. Anyone who can see the repository's work items may read it.

The token needs `issue:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_repository_by_path" "api" {
  full_path = "acme/platform/api"
}

resource "gitmoap_repository_milestone" "v2" {
  repo_id = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
  title   = "v2.0"
}

data "gitmoap_repository_milestone" "api" {
  milestone_id = gitmoap_repository_milestone.v2.milestone_id
  repo_id      = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `milestone_id` (String) Milestone ID
- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID

### Read-Only

- `cancelled` (Number)
- `closed` (Boolean)
- `completed` (Number)
- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `due_on` (String) A calendar day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, with no time and no zone — a due date, or the day an iteration starts or ends.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `open` (Number)
- `points_completed` (Number)
- `points_total` (Number)
- `scope_id` (String)
- `scope_type` (String)
- `title` (String)
- `total` (Number)
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `issue_ref` (Attributes) Names a work item from outside its own repository or group, since a number like `#412` only identifies an issue within one of them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--issue_ref))
- `issue_uid` (String)
- `linked_at` (String)
- `milestone_id` (String)
- `points` (Number)
- `status_category` (String) The fixed category behind a status. A status also has a *name*, which the team owns and may
rename freely; the category is the part the platform reasons about. A team can call a status
"Ready for QA" and the platform still knows it is `in_review` — so a board can place it in a
column, a merge can move it, and a progress rollup can count it as not done.
- `work_item_type` (String) The kind of work item. The type decides where an item may live (a group or a repository), which
types it may have as children, and which fields it accepts.

<a id="nestedatt--items--issue_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.issue_ref`

Read-Only:

- `iid` (Number)
- `scope` (Attributes) A group or a repository, whichever a setting belongs to.

Set one of `group` or `repo`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--issue_ref--scope))

<a id="nestedatt--items--issue_ref--scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.issue_ref.scope`

Read-Only:

- `group` (String)
- `repo` (String)
